attempts.summary: Configured sudo on node1 to log every command (with user, host, PWD, and timestamp) to a dedicated /var/log/sudo-commands.log via a sudoers.d Defaults snippet (logfile= + !syslog to suppress duplicate syslog/secure-log entries), verified isolation from /var/log/secure, /var/log/messages, and journald using marker strings, then performed the mandatory single-node reboot with boot_id proof and re-verified the logging config and file persisted and continued working after restart.
